name: Ikenai Ayaka Nee-san to Yarisugi Yuuwaku Seikatsu ~Kawaiin Dakara♪ Zenbu Makasete... Genki na Aka-chan Tsukurimasho♪~
original_name: イケナイ綾香姉さんとヤリすぎ誘惑生活～可愛いんだから♪全部任せて…元気な赤ちゃん作りましょ♪～
source:
She's got the words of a siren and the body of a vixen...
sexy elder sister is too aggressive, and it's wrong!

The protagonist can't handle his sister's sex appeal any more. He decides to live alone. But she still shows up to check on him, and catches him masturbating! His confession cums in a gush... he's always lusted for her, and she confesses the same to him! A kiss becomes a forbidden tangle of sibling incest...

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE079527.html]DLsite English[/url]]
